headline: Two down, twelve to go — early chalk holds, carnage awaits
dek: The 2025 Trash Talk Pool season opened with a pair of tight West Coast battles Thursday night. Ben and Orest sit 1-0 while Adrian and Tymko nurse early wounds, but seven entrants haven't kicked off yet and three head-to-heads loom Sunday and Monday.
takeaways: The public loved the 49ers laying points on a short week — Ben's Niners covered easily and then some, 27-7.
Adrian's Patriots couldn't protect Drake Maye, who threw three picks in Seattle including a backbreaker late.
Tymko's Rams got boat-raced at home in primetime — not the start anyone saw coming for a team that spent the offseason talking big.

games.text:
Orest's Seahawks edged Adrian's Patriots 13-10 in a defensive slugfest to open the season Thursday night in Seattle. Drew Lock managed the game efficiently for the Hawks, going 16-of-22 for 187 yards and a touchdown, while Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauled in 8 catches for 122 yards and the score. The Patriots' Drake Maye struggled mightily in his debut, throwing three interceptions on 23-of-33 passing despite adding a touchdown. Rhamondre Stevenson ground out 51 yards on 18 carries, but New England's offence sputtered when it mattered.

This was the first head-to-head of the season and Orest drew first blood, taking the early 1-0 edge while Adrian falls to 0-1. Both entrants have one game remaining this week — Orest's Ravens visit Indianapolis Sunday at 1 PM, while Adrian's Bucs head to Cincinnati in the same window. A 2-0 start is within reach for Orest if Baltimore takes care of business; Adrian needs Tampa to bounce back or he'll be staring at an 0-2 hole before most of the pool has even played.

Ben's 49ers dismantled Tymko's Rams 27-7 in Los Angeles in Thursday night's second game, a thorough beatdown that had the look of a playoff team toying with an overmatched opponent. Brock Purdy was surgical, completing 25-of-34 for 205 yards and three touchdowns, spreading the ball around to six different receivers. Christian McCaffrey chipped in 68 yards on the ground and Demarcus Robinson hauled in a 50-yard score. The Rams' offence, meanwhile, never got on track — Matthew Stafford threw for just 155 yards and an interception, and the LA ground game managed only 54 yards from Blake Corum on 10 carries. Puka Nacua's 5 catches for 74 yards were the lone bright spot.

Another head-to-head, another decisive result. Ben vaults to the top of the early standings with a commanding 20-point net, while Tymko sits at the bottom with a minus-20. The margin matters in a pool this tight — that 40-point swing could be the difference between a tiebreaker months from now. Ben's Texans host Chris's Bills on Sunday at 1 PM in what could be a statement game, while Tymko's Chiefs host Jordy's Broncos on Monday night. Tymko needs KC to deliver or he'll be 0-2 and chasing from the jump.

entrants.name: Ben
entrants.text: Sitting pretty at 1-0 with a +20 net after his Niners crushed Tymko's Rams. His Texans host Chris's Bills Sunday at 1 PM in a potential 2-0 setup, though Houston will have their hands full with Buffalo's offence.

entrants.name: Orest
entrants.text: Also 1-0 after his Seahawks held off Adrian's Patriots in a defensive battle. His Ravens visit Indy on Sunday — a win there and he's tied with Ben at the top of the early table.

entrants.name: Bill, Chris, Jordy, Matej, Taras
entrants.text: None of these five have played yet. Bill's Steelers and Cowboys both kick off Sunday. Chris faces a tough test with his Bills at Ben's Texans, then his Pack at Minnesota. Jordy's Lions host the Saints before his Broncos visit KC on Monday. Matej's Jags host Cleveland and his Eagles get Washington. Taras has the Panthers hosting Chicago and the Chargers hosting Arizona.

entrants.name: Adrian
entrants.text: Off to a rough start at 0-1 after his Patriots couldn't protect Drake Maye in Seattle. His Bucs visit Cincinnati on Sunday — a loss there and he's 0-2 while the rest of the pool is just getting warmed up.

entrants.name: Tymko
entrants.text: The worst opening night imaginable — his Rams got demolished at home by Ben's 49ers, leaving him 0-1 with a pool-worst minus-20 net. His Chiefs host Jordy's Broncos on Monday night in another head-to-head. Lose that and the hole gets deep fast.

ahead: Sunday's 1 PM window features a massive head-to-head: Chris's Bills at Ben's Texans. Winner goes 2-0 or stays perfect.
Monday night brings Jordy's Broncos at Tymko's Chiefs — Tymko desperate to avoid 0-2, Jordy looking to start clean.
By Tuesday morning we'll know who's really in trouble and who's sitting pretty. Right now it's just Thursday night carnage and a lot of teams that haven't played yet.
